name: zclass_camera_translate_target
description: zClass_Camera::gwCameraTranslateTarget adds a target delta to the selected camera target vector.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass_Camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x44a1a0 validates camera node/class checking, mode-dependent target vector selection, target delta addition, child activation when listCountA is nonzero, wrong-class return 3, and null/class-data error handling.
The native camera smoke verifies direct target translation in both target modes plus wrong-class/null handling.
